about: Scheduled jobs on this repo, kept by the scheduled-jobs skill (https://github.com/mikedepo/paperclip-cloudcli): every change to a job is a commit of this file. Each job runs its prompt in this repo with Claude Code (the Runner agent), or with the agent its "agent" names (Codex: OpenAI's Codex), on its 5-field cron schedule in its time zone; paused jobs don't run. To recreate them on a new server: node ~/.claude/skills/scheduled-jobs/jobs.mjs restore
